summary:
Main
Iron ore futures opened weaker on Wednesday before recovering through the session. The DCE most-traded I2701 contractsettled at 738.5 yuan/mt, down 0.27% from the previous session. Qingdao port spot prices fell by an average of around 8 yuan/mt, with traders showing only moderate enthusiasm in offering and mills reluctant to buy.
